name: CineFy
description: Cinematic entertainment booking and authentic cricket stadium interactive seating maps featuring HPCA Stadium (Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh) with its Himalayan Tibetan pagoda pavilion, red & white roofs, Dhauladhar snow mountain backdrop, blue seating blocks, and 6 high-mast floodlights, alongside Narendra Modi Stadium and Rajiv Gandhi Uppal Stadium.
